notes.title: Update Notes For April 25
notes.notes: We have resolved the issue of stuttering when using OpenVR.

notes.title: Update Notes for 23.05.17
notes.notes: 1.We have fixed a bug that prevented mini-games from being played properly in the Practice Range. 2.We have made improvements to smoothen the player's movement.

notes.title: Update Notes for 23.05.11
notes.notes: The game has been modified to be executable through OpenXR(Oculus Quest 2).

notes.title: Update Notes for 23.05.02
notes.notes:
1. We have resolved the issue where some destruction sounds were not being played properly.
2. We have added a structure removal option to allow for smoother frame rates during gameplay.

notes.title: Minor bug fix for 23.04.29
notes.notes:
1. We have resolved the issue where the modeling of the wand was not being displayed properly. 
2. We have also fixed the problem where both victory and defeat sounds were being played at the same time upon winning a round.

notes.title: Bug fix for April.25
notes.notes: We have resolved the issue of some sound assets not being output properly

notes.title: Minor bug fix
notes.notes: We have fixed the bug where the trail of hevay and weak attacks appeared blue.

notes.title: Update Notes for 23.04.22
notes.notes:
We have fixed the bug where magic does not collide with buildings.
We have added a simple tutorial to each scene. 
We have updated it to make crossplay possible. 
We have fixed both major and minor bugs.

notes.title: Minor bug fix
notes.notes: We have resolved the issue where spell casting was intermittently interrupted in the tutorial scene.

notes.title: Minor bug fix
notes.notes: We have updated the description for the Stone Golem

notes.title: Translation system has been added
notes.notes: Now you can use both English and Korean! Other languages are also coming soon.

notes.title: Cannon Tower Rotator Bug Fix
notes.notes: Fixed problem that rotator does not rotate
